scientific_limitations: Only the specified two-state two-channel Markov jump switch with binary input, a common input-independent initial law and readout time, constant control per task, terminal occupation mean and threshold 1/2. Preparation cost and single-trajectory error not optimized.
title: Three-task transient capacity and a sharp readout optimum for a two-channel stochastic switch
